text: Cambricon's third-quarter revenue rose 105% to 3.53 billion yuan ($529 million), but analysts expected about 6.26 billion, Bloomberg reports. Net income rose 148% to 1.4 billion yuan. Bloomberg ties the miss to chip output and memory shortages.
